title: focuser_primaluce accepted moves on an uncalibrated SESTO SENSO 3, which acknowledges GOTO and does not move
summary: With CAL_MAXPOS not above CAL_MINPOS the controller answers GOTO with done and stays; the driver published the move and ended it without a reason.
evidence: 20261022235021-bcb6-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md (FND-000054); hardware probe of the delivered unit

resolution.evidence: 20261022235021-bcb6-primaluce-sestosenso3/verification.md: such moves are refused with 'The focuser is not calibrated'; sestosenso3_uncalibrated and sestosenso3_calibration_restart pass.
